item.title: Version 1.3
item.description:
Share your recaps. Send any recap as a link. People open it in their browser, no app or account needed, and can download it as a PDF. Links are locked on your Mac, so not even CoBuild can read them.

  • Optional password, expiry, or share only with people you invite
  • One Share button for links and downloads
  • Claude can answer about your recaps even when your Mac is off, from summaries and notes (transcripts stay on your Mac)
  • Clearer messages while transcription gets ready
  • Bug fixes and improvements

item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
Ask Claude about your meetings. Recap now works with CoBuild for Claude. Switch it on in Settings, AI and Claude can find your recaps and answer questions about them while Recap is open. Needs CoBuild Pro.

  • Drag the Start a recap button anywhere in the window
  • A small floating pill lets you stop a recording while Recap is minimised or hidden

item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
Ask your meetings. A new Ask tab answers questions about any recap, and ⌘J asks across all of them. One click writes the follow-up email.

  • Your notes shape the summary, and moments you mark get covered
  • Live transcript beside your notes while recording
  • Recap types, renaming speakers, and shortcuts that work from any app
  • Built-in AI for summaries, nothing to set up
  • Recaps start straight away while Whisper gets ready, and the Mac audio permission check is fixed
